title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・君臨する悪役

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek shuts Oguri Cap out with a tenacious run, seizing the victory for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek has won race after race intent on earning me the title of "best trainer in the world."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to make this dream a reality, the next race she chooses to run in is… the Arima Kinen!
